note: One versioned list. The enforced_baseline is the set design-authority-projector.mjs has always emitted; it is never reduced. Guided generation adds the guided_additional set on top. Copying either list into a prompt by hand is how the two drift, so prompts read this registry.

enforced_baseline.detects: invented values presented as real product data
lorem ipsum or unresolved copy shipped as content
controls with no action, destination or state behind them
undifferentiated template output with no DIAL design grammar
donor branding presented as DIAL brand authority
internal identifiers surfaced to the end user

guided_additional.detects: cards inside cards inside cards with no hierarchy gained
gradients with no token, role or brand justification
pill chips used as the default container for unrelated content
competing emphasis with no clear primary
the same destination offered twice in one viewport
numbers, trends or KPIs with no product data source
a hero region carrying no primary task or product truth
an undifferentiated vertical stack standing in for information architecture
corner radii outside the declared radius scale
mixed icon stroke weights or families in one surface
charts present for visual weight rather than a user decision
promotional claims with no governed promotion or pricing authority behind them
motion with no feedback, continuity, orientation, causality, hierarchy, accessibility or bounded brand purpose
critical or destructive action available only through an undiscoverable gesture
animation cannot reconcile when authoritative state changes mid-transition
desktop composition merely shrunk onto mobile/tablet without interaction recomposition
multiple unrelated easing/spring/duration styles create incoherent product behavior
meaningful action produces no immediate visible or semantic acknowledgement
nonessential motion lacks a reduced-motion equivalent
nested or competing gestures make intended manipulation ambiguous or unreliable
interaction conflicts with target platform navigation, input or accessibility expectations
loading, error, offline, degraded or permission states are styled but not behaviorally designed
professional workflow slowed or distracted by excessive decorative motion
